title: 第9章 工作第10章 竞争激烈和3级健体
content_zh:
当天放学后。
食堂里。
张羽和周天翊、白真真正坐在一块吃晚饭。
白真真仍旧是像平时一样，冷冰冰的不说话，正淡定地对着自己面前的一大盘饭菜默默输出。
周天翊则看了张羽一眼说道“你最近的经济状况有点糟糕啊。”
“这么明显吗？”
张羽微微一愣，心想难道催款电话已经打给同学了？那岂不是他欠债七十万的事情要在学校里被戳破了？
周天翊看了一眼白真真那鸡鸭鱼肉俱全的丰盛晚餐，又看了一眼张羽那价值5块钱的穷鬼套餐。
他摸了摸下巴说道“根据我这三个月来对食堂的观察，一个人在食堂吃什么，能够有效反应出他在那段时间的经济状况，甚至是修为实力。”
“比如一顿吃十斤的人，是不会和一顿吃三斤的人坐一桌的。”
“因为双方完全不是一个阶层，分别处在校园鄙视链的上游和下游。”
“原来是看我吃得少啊。”张羽心中松了一口气，还以为自己超级穷人的身份要曝光了呢。
他转头看向白真真，看着对方饭桶里的十几个鸡腿，一脸好奇道“阿真，这鸡腿看上去好特别啊，给我尝一个呗。”
白真真头也不抬地说道“爬。”
一旁的周天翊笑着从自己碗里给张羽夹了个鸭腿“真真今天运动量特别大，一看就是饿急了，你尝尝我的吧。”
“好兄弟！”张羽朝着周天翊竖起一个大拇指，抓过鸭腿便啃了起来。
周天翊看着张羽狼吞虎咽的模样，微微一笑道“如果遇到资金困难了，我可以借你点。”
张羽摆了摆手说道“不用了，我自己会解决。”
虽然欠了一屁股债，但张羽并不打算问同学借钱，或者说问同学借钱也不可能一口气解决七十万巨债的问题，他需要的是持续赚钱，持续还债的方法。
“至少要把每个月的利息还上，不能再让催收的升级手段了。”

张羽知道随着他逾期的时间不断增长，催收公司的手段也将越来越厉害。从线上侮辱，到线下真实，一步比一步厉害。
“还有房租，水电费，伙食费……”
想到这里，张羽感觉自己开始头疼了。
就在周天翊走了以后，白真真突然开口说道“根据我这三个月来对你和周天翊的观察，他对你特别好。”
张羽“有吗？”
白真真呵呵一笑道“一个男的笑着把自己碗里的鸭腿给另一个男的，我活了十六年只看到过两种情况发生这种事情。”
“一种，双方是父子关系。”
“另一种，嘿嘿嘿嘿……”
张羽眉头一挑“阿真，你看的东西挺杂啊。”
白真真“羽子，其实你也不用害怕，反正在这学校里，你才是掌握主动能力的那个。”
说着，白真真将自己的餐盘一推，放到了张羽的面前“唉，吃不下啦，这些剩菜剩饭就赏你了吧，谁叫你是我的好大儿呢。”
“爬。”张羽一把抢过餐盘，目光一扫，便能看到里面摆放得整整齐齐，一看就没有动过的小半饭菜。
正当张羽抬起头来想要谢谢对方时，却只看到白真真离开食堂的背影。
走到食堂外，白真真的目光重新淡了下来，她心中暗道“羽子啊，其实还有第三种情况，也会这样的。”
白真真转头看向食堂门口的台阶上，一名食堂阿姨正在将泔水桶的剩饭剩菜倒进一只猫的碗里。
……
离开学校，张羽便开始计划找赚钱的路子了。
“我现在房租一千五，水电每个月两百多左右，贷款每个月要还一万五……”
content_en:
After school that day.
In the cafeteria.
Zhang Yu, Zhou Tianyi and Bai Zhenzhen were sitting together for dinner.
Bai Zhenzhen was still as usual, cold and silent, calmly speaking silently to the large plate of food in front of him.
Zhou Tianyi glanced at Zhang Yu and said, "Your recent financial situation is a bit bad."
"Is it so obvious?"
Zhang Yu was slightly stunned, thinking that the collection call had already been made to his classmates? Doesn't that mean that his debt of 700,000 yuan will be revealed in school?
Zhou Tianyi glanced at Bai Zhenzhen's sumptuous dinner of chicken, duck, fish and meat, and then at Zhang Yu's poor man's set meal worth 5 yuan.
He touched his chin and said, "Based on my observations of the cafeteria in the past three months, what a person eats in the cafeteria can effectively reflect his economic status and even his cultivation strength during that period."
"For example, a person who eats ten pounds in a meal will not sit at the same table as a person who eats three pounds in a meal."
"Because the two sides are not of the same class at all. They are respectively upstream and downstream in the chain of contempt on campus."
"It turns out it's because I don't eat enough." Zhang Yu breathed a sigh of relief, thinking that his status as a super poor man was about to be exposed.
He turned to look at Bai Zhenzhen, looking at the dozen chicken drumsticks in the other person's rice bucket, and said curiously, "Azhen, these drumsticks look so special, give me a try."
Bai Zhenzhen said, "Climb."
Zhou Tianyi on the side smiled and gave Zhang Yu a duck leg from his bowl, "I really exercised a lot today. I look like I'm hungry. You can try mine."
"Good brother!" Zhang Yu gave Zhou Tianyi a thumbs up, grabbed the duck leg and started to chew on it.
Zhou Tianyi looked at Zhang Yu wolfing down the food, smiled slightly and said, "If you encounter financial difficulties, I can lend you some."
Zhang Yu waved his hand and said, "No, I will handle it myself."
Although he owes a lot of debt, Zhang Yu has no intention of asking his classmates to borrow money. In other words, asking his classmates to borrow money will not solve the problem of a huge debt of 700,000 yuan in one go. What he needs is a way to continue to make money and continue to pay off debts.
"At least the monthly interest must be paid, and we cannot let the debt collectors escalate."
Zhang Yu knew that as his overdue period continued to increase, the collection company's methods would become more and more powerful. From online insults to offline truths, each step becomes more powerful.
"There are also rent, water and electricity bills, food expenses..."
Thinking of this, Zhang Yu felt like he was starting to have a headache.
Just after Zhou Tianyi left, Bai Zhenzhen suddenly said, "According to my observations of you and Zhou Tianyi in the past three months, he is very good to you."
Zhang Yu: "Is there any?"
Bai Zhenzhen laughed and said, "A man smiled and gave the duck legs in his bowl to another man. I have only seen this happen in two situations in my sixteen years of life."
"One way, both parties have a father-son relationship."
"Another kind, hehehehehe..."
Zhang Yu raised his eyebrows and said, "Azhen, what you are looking at is quite complicated."
Bai Zhenzhen: "Yuzi, actually you don't have to be afraid. Anyway, in this school, you are the one who has the initiative."
With that said, Bai Zhenzhen pushed his dinner plate and put it in front of Zhang Yu, "Oh, I can't eat any more. I'll just reward you with these leftovers. Who told you that you are my eldest son?"
"Climb." Zhang Yu grabbed the dinner plate, and with a quick glance, he could see half of the food neatly arranged inside, which looked untouched at first glance.
Just when Zhang Yu raised his head and wanted to thank the other party, he only saw Bai Zhenzhen's back leaving the cafeteria.
Walking outside the cafeteria, Bai Zhenzhen's eyes dimmed again, and she secretly said in her heart, "Yu Zi, there is actually a third situation, and it will be like this."
Bai Zhenzhen turned to look at the steps at the door of the cafeteria, where a cafeteria aunt was pouring the leftovers from the swill bucket into a cat's bowl.
…
After leaving school, Zhang Yu began to plan to find a way to make money.Way to go.
"My current rent is 1,500 yuan, water and electricity are about 200 yuan per month, and the loan repayment is 15,000 yuan per month..."
